method: Soft voting: average of the members' softmax probabilities (equal weights)
explanation: Full-data version of E9 (soft vote of E10a + E10b). Kaggle public 0.97914 vs 0.97671 for E9: +0.24 pts from 25% more data; best public score of the project. Agrees with E9 on 98.7% of test images. Note: public LB = ~50% of test (~4940 images), 1 SE ~ 0.2 pts, so single-model vs ensemble differences at this level are within noise.
preprocessing_why: Members see the image at different resolutions, so their errors are partly independent.
name: Erdem SANVER
